text: The meeting covered action items including Christine's investigation of the advanced chip prior to the next meeting and the submission of the prototype design to management (items 0, 1).
ME will develop the marketing strategy and market the product after price is determined (items 2, 9).

A central issue identified is cost, and key decisions were made on the remote control concept, the functional design, using wood for the remote case, integrating solar cells and the microphone and speaker on the advanced chip, and revisiting the display option after cost information is known (items 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11).
The team decided to stick with the simple design for the time being (item 8).
